title: System
lede: Health of the database, storage, AI gateway and sandbox, plus job ingest and webhooks.

loadError.title: We could not load the system status.
loadError.hint: The server did not answer. Check the connection, then try again.

health.title: Health
health.description: Checked every 5 minutes. Each bar is 30 minutes of the last 24 hours.

slot.warn: Down for part of this time

ingest.title: Job ingest
ingest.description: The latest run for each job board. Select a board to see its history.
ingest.empty: No ingest run has finished yet.
ingest.emptyHint: Each job board appears here after the first scheduled run.
ingest.historyNote: The latest run and earlier runs that did not complete.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Deliveries to the endpoints users set up. Only the host of each endpoint is shown.
webhooks.notDead: Only failed deliveries can be sent again. Refresh the list.
webhooks.loadError: We could not load the deliveries.

emptyHint.dead: A delivery that fails after all retries appears here, and you can send it again.
emptyHint.pending: Deliveries waiting for their first or next attempt appear here.
emptyHint.all: Deliveries appear when a project event reaches a webhook a user has set up.

gateway.title: AI gateway
gateway.description: Models are served by the local LiteLLM gateway. This card is read-only.
gateway.hint: Set OPENROUTER_API_KEY in .env and restart the infrastructure.

status.notConfigured: The AI gateway is not configured.
status.reachable: The AI gateway is configured and reachable.
status.unreachable: The AI gateway is configured but not reachable right now.

tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Tools that connected AI assistants can call. A project token needs the capability shown to use one.

connect.title: Open the connection channel
connect.description: External AI assistants (MCP, A2A, REST) can connect only while the listener is on. Run this on the machine that hosts the app, then reload the Connect page.
connect.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the command and copy it by hand.
